name: Sharkry

skills.name: Love Shot
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Boiling Soundwaves
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles, applies Overburn for 1 turns, and deals Burn damage equal to 140% of attack to them. If the user is under the effects of Zoom in, increases Stability Damage dealt by 1 point.

skills.name: Perfect Rising Tone
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles, dealing Physical damage equal to 150% of attack to them. Gains Zoom In. If the target is inflicted with Overburn, applies 2 stacks of Flammable before the attack, and changes the damage type to Burn damage.

skills.name: Highlight Moment
skills.description: Gains 1 stack of Zoom In and 1 instance of Extra Command.

skills.name: Makeup Organization
skills.description: At the start of action, gains 1 point of Confectance Index. When Overburn is applied to an enemy target, gains 1 point of Confectance Index. Critical rate increases by 20% against targets with Overburn.

fortification.effect: Increases the duration of Overburn by 1 turn.
The user gains Damage Up I for 1 turn.
If a kill is scored, gains 1 additional stack of Zoom In.
Critical rate is incresed by 10% against targets with Overburn. Critical damage is increased by 3 % for each active buff, up to a maximum of 15%.
The effects of Zoom In are enhanced, increasing damage dealt by 5%.
At the start of action, gains 1 stack of Zoom In.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Devilish Whisper
keys.effect: Gains 3 points of Confectance Index at the start of the battle.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Thermal Feedback
keys.effect: When an enemy target within range is affected by Overburn, perform 1 instance of Wise Support, dealing Physical damage equal to 80% of attack and 2 points of Stability Damage to them. This can be triggered up to 3 times per turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Deadly Allure
keys.effect: At the start of this unit's action, if there is an enemy with Overburn on the field, gains Blazing Assault II for 1 turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Idol Training Day
keys.effect: When using the active skill Perfect Rising Tone, if the target has Overburn, gains Blazing Assault II before attack for 2 turns.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Target Is Your Heart
keys.effect: When using the active skill Boiling Soundwaves, if a kill is scored, gain 1 stack of Zoom In.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Palm-Blown Kiss
keys.effect: When attacking a target with Overburn, restores 20% of max HP.

keys.name: Common Key - Opening Fireworks
keys.effect: CRIT +3.0% / If the unit has more than 1 buff, increase damage dealt by 7%.

keys.name: Expansion Key
keys.effect: Damage dealt by Wise Support is changed to Burn damage.
